headline: Oobli & Cosun sugar replacer for chocolate; FDA GRAS overhaul; Galy cultured cocoa
summary: Galy is bringing cell-cultured cocoa to US consumers (WunderHaus) and professional kitchens, a direct partnership target and competitive threat for Belcolade.
FDA proposed GRAS rule changes that would tighten oversight of self-affirmed ingredients; Puratos should audit US dossiers for enzymes, cultures and novel ingredients and track the comment period.
Sweet-protein start-up Oobli and Cosun Ingredients launched a sugar-replacer system for chocolate, a ready benchmark and possible partner for sugar-reduced Belcolade and fillings.

Pressure for a federal ultra-processed food definition is mounting while FDA's salt-substitute rule for 139 standardized foods takes effect December 14, so bakery customers will need clean-label and sodium-reduction solutions.

Grupo Bimbo is adding fibre and seeking product changes as North American volumes fall, opening sell-in for fibre, protein and taste solutions; MOA Foodtech and Espiga's bakery egg replacer is one to watch for Patisserie.

items.title: Oobli, Cosun Ingredients Create Sugar Replacer for Chocolate Amid Sweet Protein Expansion
items.summary: US sweet-protein start-up Oobli co-developed a sugar replacement system for chocolate with Cosun Ingredients and is widening access to its monellin ingredient.
items.why: A ready sugar-replacer system for chocolate from a start-up plus a major ingredient supplier: a partnership target and competitive benchmark for sugar-reduced Belcolade and fillings.

items.title: Cocoa prices driving squeeze for confectionery makers
items.summary: Headline report that high cocoa prices continue to squeeze confectionery makers' margins.
items.why: Ongoing cocoa cost pressure keeps demand up for cocoa-saving recipes, compounds and alternatives from Belcolade.

items.title: What Is Ultra-Processed Food? FDA Pushed To Give Definition
items.summary: FDA is being pushed to publish a formal definition of ultra-processed food.
items.why: A federal UPF definition would directly affect packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; prepare clean-label, fewer-additive reformulation options for customers.

items.title: Nutrition experts press White House to release ultra-processed food definition
items.summary: Nutrition experts are pressing the White House to release its ultra-processed food definition.
items.why: Signals a UPF definition may land soon; packaged bakery customers will look to Puratos for clean-label solutions.

items.title: FDA seeks greater oversight of food ingredients through proposed GRAS rule changes
items.summary: FDA has proposed GRAS rule changes that would give it more oversight of food ingredients, likely curbing self-affirmed GRAS.
items.why: Many enzymes, cultures and novel ingredients rely on self-affirmed GRAS; Puratos should audit its US ingredient dossiers and watch the comment period.

items.title: Bimbo has the capacity but where are the bakery buyers?
items.summary: Grupo Bimbo's margins are improving but North American volumes keep falling, pushing it to new channels and product changes.
items.why: The largest NA customer seeking product changes to regain volume is a sell-in opening for health, fibre and taste solutions.

items.title: Could climate change leave bakers with flour that won’t perform?
items.summary: Trade article on whether climate change will yield flour with weaker baking performance.
items.why: Variable flour quality raises demand for enzymes and improvers that correct it, core to S500 and Bakery services.

items.title: Thermal Processing of Watermeal for High-Protein Gluten-Free Rice Bread: Effects on Functional and Quality Properties
items.summary: Vacuum-dried watermeal (Wolffia) powder at up to 20% raised protein and fibre in gluten-free rice bread and strengthened the batter.
items.why: A novel aquatic-plant protein for gluten-free, high-protein bread mixes; early-stage but on-theme for Bakery enrichment.

items.title: Valorization of Wheat Milling Co-Products in Carasau Bread: Effects of Their Addition as Powders or After Fermentation on Physicochemical Properties, Volatile Profile and Sensory Characteristics
items.summary: Wheat germ, bran and middlings were added to Sardinian carasau bread either as powders or after sourdough fermentation, changing aroma, texture and consumer liking.
items.why: Shows fermenting milling by-products before use tunes flavour, an upcycled sourdough ingredient idea for Sapore.

items.title: Dirty Dozen™ food chemicals: Titanium dioxide
items.summary: EWG lists titanium dioxide among its 'Dirty Dozen' food chemicals, adding pressure for its removal.
items.why: Titanium dioxide whitening in icings, decorations and coatings faces growing US pressure; have TiO2-free alternatives ready for Patisserie and Chocolate customers.

items.title: Why candy prices are scary high ahead of Halloween
items.summary: Rising ingredient costs have pushed Halloween candy prices up, with Hershey adding salty snacks to its options.
items.why: Cocoa costs are reshaping confectioners' portfolios; an opening for cocoa-saving Belcolade and compound solutions.

items.title: WinCo Foods hoagie rolls recalled in 7 states over undeclared sesame
items.summary: WinCo Foods hoagie rolls were recalled in seven states over undeclared sesame.
items.why: Another sesame recall in rolls; bakery customers must keep sesame cross-contact controls and labelling tight since it became a major allergen.

items.title: Publisher's Platform: The food Traceability Rule has been law since 2022 – nobody has to follow it until 2028. Here is how that happened, and what FDA is doing with the time.
items.summary: Commentary on why FDA's Food Traceability Rule, final since 2022, now has a 2028 compliance date and what FDA is doing in the meantime.
items.why: Gives customers until 2028 for lot-level traceability; plan supplier record systems on that timeline.

items.title: WinCo Foods LLC Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Sesame in Hoagie Rolls
items.summary: FDA posted WinCo Foods' allergy alert on undeclared sesame in its hoagie rolls.
items.why: Reinforces FDA attention on sesame labelling in bread; customers should review allergen controls.

items.title: Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls for Human Food; Draft Guidance for Industry; Availability
items.summary: FDA released a draft Chapter 12, Control of Chemical Hazards, of its preventive-controls guidance for human food.
items.why: Plants and customers will need to reflect FDA's chemical-hazard expectations in food safety plans; review with QA.
